# Flourrish Asset Management

> Flourrish Asset Management is a Chennai-based property management company for NRI and local property owners. Founded by Shakeel and Farrah, it looks after apartments, villas, independent houses, offices and vacant properties across OMR, ECR and South Chennai.

Key facts:
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Areas: OMR (Perungudi, Thoraipakkam, Sholinganallur), ECR, South Chennai (Adyar, Besant Nagar, Velachery), GST Road suburbs (Tambaram, Pallavaram, Medavakkam, Chengalpattu)
- Clients: NRI property owners abroad (USA, Canada, UAE and the Gulf, UK, Europe, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia) and local owners in Chennai
- Owner approval is required for major repairs, large expenses, new tenants, rent changes, lease renewals and renovations
- Monthly report with photos and a video walkthrough; urgent issues sent on WhatsApp
- Legal, tax and banking matters are coordinated with qualified professionals; Flourrish does not give legal or tax advice
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 99440 70397 (primary); alternate phone +91 73585 86876
- Website: https://flourrishassets.com/

## Main pages
- [Home](https://flourrishassets.com/): overview of the service
- [Services](https://flourrishassets.com/services.html): all services in five groups: land, building, commercial, owner support and NRI
- [EC check](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-ec-check.html): We get the Encumbrance Certificate for your land, read it line by line and tell you in plain words whether the title is clean.
- [Patta & Chitta verification](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-patta-chitta-verification.html): We confirm that the Patta, Chitta and FMB records match your sale deed, and help you get them corrected if they do not.
- [Regular land visits](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-site-visits.html): A member of our team visits your plot on a fixed schedule and sends you photos, video and a short note the same day.
- [Boundary & encroachment check](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-boundary-encroachment-check.html): We check that your plot is where the records say it is, that the boundary stones are in place, and that nobody has moved in.
- [Renting or leasing land](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-leasing.html): Earn from land you are not using yet. We find a suitable tenant, set up a proper lease and collect the rent for you.
- [Land tax payments](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-tax-payments.html): We pay your land revenue, property tax and other dues on time, with your authorisation, and keep every receipt.
- [Sale assistance](https://flourrishassets.com/services/land-sale-assistance.html): When you decide to sell, we get the papers in order, bring buyers, and see the deal through to registration.
- [Tenant sourcing](https://flourrishassets.com/services/tenant-sourcing.html): We market your apartment, villa or house, handle every enquiry and run the viewings, so you only hear from us when there is a good tenant.
- [Tenant verification](https://flourrishassets.com/services/tenant-verification.html): Before anyone moves in, we check who they are, where they work and how they have rented before.
- [Rent agreements](https://flourrishassets.com/services/rent-agreements.html): A clear written agreement, prepared with legal support and registered, so both sides know exactly what was agreed.
- [Rent collection](https://flourrishassets.com/services/rent-collection.html): Rent is tracked, reminded and followed up every month, and you see it in your monthly report.
- [Move-in & move-out](https://flourrishassets.com/services/move-in-move-out.html): Every handover is recorded with photos, meter readings and a signed inventory, so deposits are settled fairly.
- [Property inspections](https://flourrishassets.com/services/property-inspections.html): Regular visits with a written condition report, so small problems are found before they become expensive ones.
- [Video walkthroughs](https://flourrishassets.com/services/video-walkthroughs.html): A room-by-room video of your property, so you can see it yourself instead of reading about it.
- [Maintenance coordination](https://flourrishassets.com/services/maintenance-coordination.html): Repairs handled from start to finish: estimate, your approval, the work, then completion photos.
- [Emergency response](https://flourrishassets.com/services/emergency-response.html): Leaks, electrical faults, storm damage or break-ins: we respond, make the property safe and keep you informed.
- [Vacant property care](https://flourrishassets.com/services/vacant-property-care.html): An empty home needs looking after too. We visit, air it, check for leaks and pests, and keep it ready for use.
- [Commercial tenant sourcing](https://flourrishassets.com/services/commercial-tenant-sourcing.html): Offices, shops and warehouses need the right business as a tenant. We find, screen and present them to you.
- [Lease management](https://flourrishassets.com/services/commercial-lease-management.html): Lease drafting, registration, rent escalation, renewals and exits, all tracked so nothing is missed.
- [Fit-out coordination](https://flourrishassets.com/services/commercial-fit-out.html): When a tenant moves in or out, we coordinate the fit-out and restoration so the space is handed over as agreed.
- [Commercial maintenance](https://flourrishassets.com/services/commercial-maintenance.html): AC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety and common areas kept in order, with estimates before work and photos after.
- [Property tax](https://flourrishassets.com/services/property-tax.html): Property tax paid on time with your authorisation, and the receipt saved where you can find it.
- [Utility bills](https://flourrishassets.com/services/utility-bills.html): Electricity, water, gas and other bills paid on time, reported monthly, and never a disconnection.
- [RWA & association liaison](https://flourrishassets.com/services/rwa-association-liaison.html): Association dues, notices, meetings and approvals handled on your behalf.
- [Owner reports](https://flourrishassets.com/services/owner-reports.html): One monthly report covering rent, tenant, condition and expenses, so you always know where things stand.
- [NRI support](https://flourrishassets.com/services/nri-support.html): TDS, FEMA, Power of Attorney and repatriation coordinated with our CA and legal partners.
- [NRI property management](https://flourrishassets.com/nri-property-management.html): how NRIs abroad use the service
- [FAQ](https://flourrishassets.com/faq.html): 27 questions and answers
- [About](https://flourrishassets.com/about.html): company facts, founders and mission
- [Contact](https://flourrishassets.com/contact.html): free consultation

## Areas in Chennai
- [OMR](https://flourrishassets.com/areas/omr.html): Flourrish manages apartments and homes along OMR (Old Mahabalipuram Road, officially Rajiv Gandhi Salai), including Perungudi, Thoraipakkam and Sholinganallur. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle association dues and repairs with your approval, and send a monthly video report.
- [ECR](https://flourrishassets.com/areas/ecr.html): Flourrish looks after villas, beach houses and independent homes on ECR (East Coast Road), Chennai. We manage tenants where the home is rented, and run regular care visits where it stands empty: cleaning, leak and damp checks, garden and security checks, and preparation before cyclone warnings.
- [South Chennai](https://flourrishassets.com/areas/south-chennai.html): Flourrish manages houses and apartments in Adyar, Besant Nagar and Velachery in South Chennai. Many are older or inherited family homes whose owners now live abroad or in another city. We find verified tenants, collect rent, keep older buildings in good repair with your approval and send a monthly report with photos and video.
- [Tambaram and GST Road](https://flourrishassets.com/areas/tambaram-gst-road.html): Flourrish manages property in Tambaram, Pallavaram, Medavakkam and Chengalpattu, Chennai's southern suburbs along GST Road. We find the first tenant for new flats, look after vacant homes and plots with regular checks, collect rent and handle repairs with your approval.

## NRI owners by country
- [USA & Canada](https://flourrishassets.com/nri/usa-canada.html): Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs living in the USA and Canada. We find and verify tenants, collect rent into your Indian account, handle repairs only with your approval and send a monthly video report. Updates arrive on WhatsApp while you sleep, and calls are arranged for your evening, which is Chennai's morning.
- [UAE & Gulf](https://flourrishassets.com/nri/uae-gulf.html): Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. With a small time difference, we can talk the same day, and we can keep your home ready for trips back or an eventual return.
- [UK & Europe](https://flourrishassets.com/nri/uk-europe.html): Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in the UK, Ireland and Europe. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. Your morning overlaps with Chennai's afternoon, so calls are easy to arrange, and we keep clear yearly records for your accountant.
- [Singapore & Australia](https://flourrishassets.com/nri/singapore-australia.html): Flourrish manages Chennai property for NRIs in Singapore, Malaysia and Australia. We find and verify tenants, collect rent, handle repairs with your approval and send monthly video reports. Your working day overlaps with ours, so updates and approvals usually happen the same day.
